ddl.name: chk_memory_entity_merge_state
ddl.value: ("status" = 'merged' AND "merged_into_entity_id" IS NOT NULL AND "merged_into_entity_id" != "id") OR ("status" != 'merged' AND "merged_into_entity_id" IS NULL)

ddl.name: chk_memory_entity_mention_span
ddl.value: ("char_start" IS NULL AND "char_end" IS NULL) OR ("char_start" >= 0 AND "char_end" > "char_start")

ddl.name: chk_memory_entity_resolution_review_pair
ddl.value: ("reviewed_by_type" IS NULL AND "reviewed_by_id" IS NULL) OR ("reviewed_by_type" IS NOT NULL AND "reviewed_by_id" IS NOT NULL)

ddl.name: chk_memory_entity_resolution_review_state
ddl.value: ("status" = 'proposed' AND "reviewed_by_id" IS NULL AND "reviewed_at" IS NULL AND "applied_at" IS NULL) OR ("status" = 'rejected' AND "reviewed_by_id" IS NOT NULL AND "reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "applied_at" IS NULL) OR ("status" = 'accepted' AND "reviewed_by_id" IS NOT NULL AND "reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "applied_at" IS NOT NULL)

ddl.name: chk_memory_entity_resolution_operation_shape
ddl.value: ("operation" IN ('link_mention', 'reassign_mention') AND "mention_id" IS NOT NULL AND "target_entity_id" IS NOT NULL AND "rollback_of_decision_id" IS NULL) OR ("operation" = 'rollback' AND "mention_id" IS NOT NULL AND "rollback_of_decision_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("operation" = 'link_alias' AND "alias_id" IS NOT NULL AND "target_entity_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("operation" IN ('merge_entities', 'split_entity') AND "source_entity_id" IS NOT NULL)

ddl.name: chk_memory_entity_head_shape
ddl.value: ("current_resolution_id" IS NULL AND "current_entity_id" IS NULL AND "last_decision_id" IS NULL) OR ("current_resolution_id" IS NOT NULL AND "last_decision_id" IS NOT NULL)

ddl.name: chk_memory_entity_resolution_shape
ddl.value: ("resolution_kind" = 'linked' AND "entity_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("resolution_kind" = 'unresolved' AND "entity_id" IS NULL)

ddl.name: chk_memory_entity_resolution_validity
ddl.value: ("status" = 'active' AND "valid_to" IS NULL) OR ("status" = 'revoked' AND "valid_to" IS NOT NULL AND datetime("valid_to") >= datetime("valid_from"))
